name: Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited
about: Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited manufactures apparels and readymade garments in India and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing of Apparel and Ready-Made Garments; and Roofing Solutions segments. It also offers aluminum/galvanized iron roofing sheets and accessories. The company was formerly known as Victory Paper and Boards (India) Limited and changed its name to Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited in September 2021. Scoobee Day Garments (India) Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ernakulam, India.
